name: Unauthorized Rogue Host & Conduit Response
description: Deterministic response procedure for unknown MAC/IP addresses communicating directly with Level 1 controllers across Purdue boundaries.
recommended_recovery_action: Verify physical switch port, quarantine rogue MAC address, and perform firmware integrity audit.
non_disruption_guarantee: Only the unknown rogue MAC address is filtered. Core SCADA controllers remain undisturbed.

steps.title: Identify Ingress Switch Port
steps.description: Log into managed switch SW-OT-01 via out-of-band console to locate the physical RJ45 port associated with the rogue MAC address.

steps.title: Port Quarantine / Lockout
steps.description: Disable the identified switch port or place it into an isolated quarantine VLAN (VLAN 999).
steps.safety_warning: Confirm port is not an uplink trunk carrying legitimate SCADA traffic before shutting down.

steps.title: Controller Memory & Baseline Audit
steps.description: Perform hash comparison of running PLC ladder logic against the verified engineering backup repository.
steps.verification_check: Logic hashes match; no unauthorized program blocks detected.
